newsitem.title: USA: ITT unit wins contracts worth $600 million.
newsitem.headline: ITT unit wins contracts worth $600 million.

text.p: ITT Industries said Wednesday that its subsidiary, ITT Federal Services Corp, has won contracts worth about $600 million to provide technical support services to U.S. government military operations.

ITT Federal Services Corp, which is a unit of ITT Defense & Electronics, said the contracts raise ITT Defense & Electronic's projected year-end backlog to $2.2 billion, up from $1.9 billion at year end 1995.
The company said the contracts cover military facilities in California, Hawaii, the United Kindgom and Germany.
